title: Checking in for a flight
objectives: Say how many bags you want to check
Ask for the gate and boarding time

courseTemplate.setting: The flight boards at 10:15 at Gate 12. An aisle seat is available, and the passenger has one suitcase.

roles.learner: A passenger checking in for a flight

courseTemplate.openingLine: Good morning. May I see your passport? Do you have a seat preference?

targetPatterns.pattern: Here you are. Could I have an aisle seat, please?
targetPatterns.example: Here you are. Could I have an aisle seat, please?

targetPatterns.pattern: Which gate is it, and when does boarding start?
targetPatterns.example: Which gate is it, and when does boarding start?

targetPatterns.pattern: I'd like a window seat, please.
targetPatterns.example: I'd like a window seat, please.

targetPatterns.pattern: Where can I check in my luggage?
targetPatterns.example: Where can I check in my luggage?

targetPatterns.pattern: My connecting flight is in three hours.
targetPatterns.example: My connecting flight is in three hours.
targetPatterns.translation: 我的转机航班在三小时后。

targetPatterns.pattern: My suitcase didn't come out on the belt.
targetPatterns.example: My suitcase didn't come out on the belt.
targetPatterns.translation: 我的行李箱没出现在传送带上。

targetPatterns.pattern: Could I get a blanket and headphones?
targetPatterns.example: Could I get a blanket and headphones?
targetPatterns.translation: 能给我一条毯子和耳机吗？

targetPatterns.pattern: How many bags am I allowed to check in?
targetPatterns.example: How many bags am I allowed to check in?

targetPatterns.pattern: Has the gate for Flight CA987 changed?
targetPatterns.example: Has the gate for Flight CA987 changed?

stages.title: Ask for an aisle seat
stages.instruction: Use the course facts to invite this task. A natural prompt is “Good morning. May I see your passport? Do you have a seat preference?”
successCriteria: The learner can ask for an aisle seat in their own words.
hints: You can start with “Here you are. Could …”

stages.title: Say how many bags you want to check
stages.instruction: Use the course facts to invite this task. A natural prompt is “Of course. How many bags are you checking in today?”
successCriteria: The learner can say how many bags you want to check in their own words.
hints: You can start with “Just one suitcase, please. …”

stages.title: Ask for the gate and boarding time
stages.instruction: Use the course facts to invite this task. A natural prompt is “Here is your boarding pass. Do you have any other questions?”
successCriteria: The learner can ask for the gate and boarding time in their own words.
hints: You can start with “Which gate is it, …”

vocabulary.example: Here is your boarding pass. Do you have any other questions?
Which gate is it, and when does boarding start?
Here you are. Could I have an aisle seat, please?
Where can I check in my luggage?

languageNotes: 中文说「登机」容易直译成 "climb the plane"，正确说法是 board the plane；「行李超重」是 overweight baggage，不是 "heavy luggage"。

warmup.prompt: Say this in English. 我想要靠窗的座位。
warmup.suggestedAnswer: I'd like a window seat, please.
